purpose: privacy-safe, read-only aggregate evidence for buyer due diligence
privacy_rules: monthly and acquisition cohorts with fewer than minimum_cohort_users are suppressed
no stable customer pseudonym or customer-level hash
suppressed cohort labels and values are not emitted
report contains aggregates only and must be handled as confidential buyer evidence
metric_truth_rules: sent RUB volume is GMV, not revenue
paid orders are payment-confirmed but not fulfilled
repeat rate is based on fulfilled sent orders only
provider mix describes recorded payment sessions and is not provider profitability
revenue gross margin EBITDA SDE CAC and LTV remain unavailable until separately reconciled
